description: A light green tabletop is in front of you with a pink phone lying face down and a short white charging cable nearby. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up and steady the phone as a right-hand object, while the left hand reaches in from the left to grasp the cable as a left-hand object and guide its connector into the phone’s charging port; once inserted, the left hand releases the cable and both hands relax away, leaving the phone connected and resting on the table.
